name: Everything Blockchain, Inc.
summary: Everything Blockchain, Inc. specializes in offering expert consulting and developing advanced solutions within the blockchain technology and cybersecurity sectors. Its suite of products and services features EB Control, a zero-trust data access platform designed for both individual and corporate clients, alongside its EB Advise and EB Build initiatives. The company, initially founded in 2017 as ObitX, Inc., officially adopted the name Everything Blockchain, Inc. in May 2021, and operates from its headquarters in Jacksonville, Florida.
